quest.title: Master's Day Off
quest.description: Today's commissions are done and dusted. Time to check up on Jean at the Cathedral.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x550, Primogem x60, Mora x33200, Teachings of Resistance x5, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x7

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hi Barbara, we're back.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Welcome back. You must be exhausted.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How is Jean doing?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm sure you must be exhausted, too.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Oh it's nothing, looking after patients is all in a day's work for me.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Jean has regained consciousness and should be back to her normal self soon enough.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's great news! Let's go and see her.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: But she just left the Cathedral. I tried to tell her she needs more rest, but she wouldn't listen.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: She tried to act like she was fine and kept saying she wanted to get some fresh air. I bet you she's gone to <color=#00E1FFFF>Lady Vennessa's place</color> again.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Where?

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Oh, that <color=#00E1FFFF>huge tree at Windrise</color>. That place is dedicated to Mondstadt's hero, Vennessa.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Jean goes there whenever she feels lost and confused deep down inside.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Barbara, that's some pretty personal stuff... How do you know so much about Jean's innermost thoughts?

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: ...Jean, uh, mentioned it to me, y'know, before she left.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Jean is still recovering, right?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Will she be okay out there on her own, in her condition?

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: That's what I'm worried about, too. But I still have work to do here...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Don't worry, we'll take over nursing duty for now.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Great! That puts my mind at rest. May the Anemo Archon protect you... and Jean.

talks.objective: Go to the big "Symbol of Vennessa" tree

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hi Jean, are you feeling better now?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Much better. I was not expecting you to come here. Thank you for your concern.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are you sure? We saw you beneath the tree just now, leaning on your sword — it looked like you were struggling.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are you sure you aren't pushing yourself too hard?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You can always rely on the other knights.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You can always rely on us.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Oh... Thank you, that means a lot to me. Hearing that boosts my spirits.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: But I must find a way to cope with minor setbacks like this on my own. Otherwise, how can I be the protector that Mondstadt needs me to be? The protector that Vennessa was...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You truly revere Vennessa, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: I do. Vennessa was the first Grand Master, a kind yet formidable woman. I have always hoped to follow in her footsteps.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: As the Lionfang Knight, she courageously overthrew the oppressive ruling aristocracy of her time. Then, she founded the Knights of Favonius and became known as the Dandelion Knight, spreading grace and compassion throughout the land.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Dandelion Knight — isn't that your title?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Hmm... Actually, all of the Knights of Favonius' Masters throughout the ages have inherited the title of "Dandelion Knight" or "Lionfang Knight."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oooh, that makes sense now.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You too want to be as gentle as the Dandelion Knight and yet as fierce as the Lionfang Knight?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Yes. I know it sounds like a huge honor, inheriting both these titles from Vennessa...

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: But I see it more as a huge responsibility.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: After all, it is a lot to live up to.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I could get used to Jean the Lionfang Knight...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Actually, Dandelion Knight suits you better.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon thinks so too!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Jean?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Who's there?

talks.objective: Hunt down the Abyss Order enemies
Hunt down the Abyss Order opponents

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Whew... This is quite a lot of excitement, considering that the idea was to relax and take it easy...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Would a drink help you relax?

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Ahh... Is there anything without alcohol?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What do you normally drink?

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Oh, y'know, I normally mix a few things together, but I always add some bright red—

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Red? Let me guess... tomatoes? No, watermelon?

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: ...Hehe, chilis! I add chili peppers.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Chili pepper!? In a drink?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are you hurt!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh, darn him and his traps!

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: How badly are you hurt? One of my own being injured because of me is the last thing I would wish for.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: ...Let me handle this alone.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No! You're in no state to handle this alone. We're coming, too!

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: ...Okay. But before we move out, at least let me heal everyone with my <color=#00E1FFFF>Dandelion Breeze</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Thanks, you're amazing!

talks.objective: Hunt down the Abyss Order opponents

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Phew... Thanks to Barbara's help, my condition is better than I thought.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The main thing is that you're safe. Now, isn't it time to get <color=#00E1FFFF>back to Mondstadt</color> and rest, Acting Grand Master?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Yes. I should at least go and thank Barbara again. I hope she is not upset with me.

talks.objective: Return to Mondstadt and talk to Jean

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: Master, you've finally returned! The Anemo Archon protects you.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Swan? Were you waiting for me? Has something happened?

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: Yes... At the <color=#00E1FFFF>Angel's Share</color>. Don't worry, it's nothing big, but...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Has there been a bar fight?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We'll go. Jean needs to rest.

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: Ah... I know I said it's nothing big, but... Alright, how can I put this... They just really need the Acting Grand Master.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Well, if you say so Swan, I will go. I should not let the other knights down.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: It's fine. Now that I have had the chance to stretch my legs, I feel much better.

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: Great! Thank you so much, you really saved me on this one.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: For goodness' sake... What is happening to the world!? Swan used to be the most honest fellow, now he's dumping things onto Jean...

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Well... Swan was clearly agitated. Maybe it is an emergency after all. Let's go and see what this is all about, shall we?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Oh? What's all this?

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: It's a thank-you party for you!

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: A thank-you party?

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Jean, when we heard the news about your illness, we were all so worried about you.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: We can only imagine how much pressure you must be under as Acting Grand Master, and you do so much work all over Mondstadt...

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: We thought that since you so rarely take any time off, we'd take this chance to throw you a party. Enjoy yourself, Jean.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: After all, you'll never let us do this once you're back at work, haha.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Huh...

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Jean?

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Huh? Is this Jean when she's... shy? I've never seen her like this!

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: It's easy to forget that outside of work, Jean is just a normal person, like anyone else.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: I... This is just all such a surprise!

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Thank you, everyone. This really means so much to me.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Hehehe. Well, it's nothing compared to the amount of work you do for all of us, day in and day out.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: But... there are so many things I still need to do...

dialogues.speaker: Crowd
dialogues.text: *sigh*

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Fear not. We wanted to make sure you could relax and enjoy yourself...

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: So while you were away, we all pitched in and finished off your work for you. Every last task.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Did you really? ...Even the issue with the food deliveries?

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: It was no different from what we see on patrol. A couple of hilichurls. Didn't take much to get rid of them.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: And the tax returns?

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: I spend so much time doing library admin. A few more pieces of paper to deal with was really nothing to worry about.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Well... What about Margaret's missing cat?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Are you kidding me?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: #That rascally Prince was apprehended by the brilliant {M#Mr.}{F#Ms.} {NICKNAME}! And {M#he}{F#she} also reclaimed my precious astral iron strings while {M#he}{F#she} was at it.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Enough already! No more thinking about work today! Enjoy yourself while you've got the chance.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: It is my honor to work alongside you all. Praise be for the Anemo Archon's guidance...

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Speaking of work... It must have been hard work to put all this together. Where did you find the time?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: #Haha... Actually, {NICKNAME} was the key organizer behind all of this.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The organizer?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: #See all this food and drink? {NICKNAME} made sure it all arrived on time.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: #Not only that, but {M#he}{F#she} cooked each one of these beautiful dishes {M#himself}{F#herself}.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: So relax already. There's no need to be so modest!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Uh... This explains a lot!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: All those last-minute urgent orders... It was you all along!

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Of course, we also have Master Diluc to thank for the venue. Otherwise, we would be looking at quite an alarming bill right about now.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: ...Despite my initial reluctance to sponsor a Knights of Favonius event in any way...

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: I, like any other citizen of Mondstadt, owe Jean my gratitude for her hard work.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Oh, Master Diluc, I—

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Alright, alright! Jean's supposed to be taking it easy. Stop crowding her!

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Agreed! Now — let the party begin!

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Hey! Having a good time?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why did you say I was the organizer?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: The thing is, Jean knows all of us so well now...

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: When someone organizes a surprise party for you, the closer you are to them, the more bashful you tend to feel about the whole thing.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: So instead, we just gave you all the credit. After all, you did do more than your fair share of the work anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So... You gave me the credit to hide your own shyness?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Of course! This party was clearly Kaeya's idea! Shy Kaeya? This is gold!

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Haha... You think so?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So you admit it!

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Hehe... I'm only indulging you since it's such a special day today.

talks.objective: Go to the second-floor terrace and look for Jean

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Oh, it is you.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Yes, I am just... getting some air.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh-oh, it seems like something's bothering Jean.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, I want to thank you again—

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Actually, I knew nothing about this whole thing either.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Either way, it is good to be here together with everyone. It has lifted my spirits.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: And it has taught me something.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: I am definitely more of a Dandelion Knight than a Lionfang Knight.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: The Lionfang Knight represents Vennessa's past — a past in which she fought hard for Mondstadt.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: But it was the Dandelion Knight that represented her hopes for the future — a future belonging to the newly formed Knights of Favonius...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Jean, Vennessa would be so proud of who you are right now.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: I do believe that Vennessa watches over us, whether from high up above, or from the wind all around us.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: #Let the Wind lead. The winds of freedom will guide us along the path that lies ahead. I hope you will continue to join us on that path, {NICKNAME}.

choices.text: Are you having a good time?

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Jean is not as strong as she comes off. It's so good that you're here for her.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: My word, the Dawn Winery's wine is every bit as delectable as they say!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: I would never be able to afford this normally, so in the spirit of enjoying the moment while it lasts... Another glass for the bard, please!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Venti can drink a frightening amount...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Ah, hello! I didn't see you there.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: I blame the wine for monopolizing my attention! Much like my ballads, it deserves to be enjoyed for generations to come.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: What is this floating sensation I feel? Have I discovered the true meaning of Anemo power?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That would be the drink talking...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: I hereby declare that every son and daughter of the City of the Wind must be compelled to taste this finest of wines... Here's to good wine!

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: That's glass number thirty-seven.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's Diluc doing?

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: I am keeping count of this bard's alarming pace of progress through my wine.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Only the Knights drink for free tonight. It seems he didn't get the message.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: When he sobers up, I will present him with the bill.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Diluc... You're a meanie!

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: ...I'm joking, of course. I highly doubt he could afford it anyway, so I shall spare him the bill.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: But I must say, the sheer volume of alcohol this fellow can put back is just not normal.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: "Leaving the hustle and bustle of the banquet behind them, the two of them stood there, together in the quiet of the night, while the rest of the world melted away around them..."

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Sounds like the sort of thing you'd find in a romantic novel, no?

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: I'm not trying to get you to recite poetry to me or anything...

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: I'm just saying, <color=#00E1FFFF>Jean went upstairs to the balcony. Alone.</color> Now's your chance... Hehe.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Amber! You look like you're about to burst into tears. Whatever is the matter?

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Two things! One, this Sweet Madame! Two, this Sticky Honey Roast!

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Did you make them?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You'd better believe it!

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Mmm... I refuse to believe it! Where did you suddenly learn to cook so well?

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: I'm going to finish eating this, and then you're going to teach me everything you know! Don't you dare try and run off!

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: *om nom nom*

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Has... Amber been drinking?
